settings.top-blocks: Which blocks to place on the top half of the target.
settings.top-mode: Which positions to place on your top half.
settings.top-quad: Whether to render a quad at the top of the hole.
settings.totem-animation: Disables rendering of the totem animation when you pop a totem.
settings.totem-pops: Disconnects when you have popped this many totems. Set to 0 to disable.
settings.tower-speed: The speed at which to tower.
settings.tracer: If tracer line is allowed to this block.
settings.tracer-hide-at-distance: Hide the trace when you are this close to the stash.
settings.tracer-max-distance: Hide the trace when you are farther than this distance from the stash.
settings.trash-items: Items that are considered trash and can be thrown out.
settings.trigger-height: How high you have to jump before a rubberband is triggered.
settings.tuned-line-color: The color of the lines of the tuned blocks being rendered.
settings.tuned-side-color: The color of the sides of the tuned blocks being rendered.
settings.uncap-bundle-scrolling: Whether to uncap the bundle scrolling feature to let you select any item.
settings.unloaded-chunks: Stops you from going into unloaded chunks.
settings.unsafe-line-color: The line color for unsafe blocks.
settings.unsafe-side-color: The side color for unsafe blocks.
settings.unsprint-in-water: Whether to stop sprinting when in water.
settings.unsprint-on-hit: Whether to stop sprinting before attacking, to ensure you get crits and sweep attacks.
settings.untuned-line-color: The color of the lines of the untuned blocks being rendered.
settings.untuned-side-color: The color of the sides of the untuned blocks being rendered.
settings.use-display-name: Uses the players server display name instead of their account name.
settings.use-fireworks: Uses firework rockets every second of your choice.
settings.use-total-count: Toggle between counting the total number of all selected entities or each entity individually.
settings.vanilla-boost-factor: The amount by which to boost the jump.
settings.vanilla-speed: The speed in blocks per second.
settings.vehicles: Whether or not reverse step should affect vehicles.
settings.velocity-height: The distance that velocity mode moves you.
settings.vertical-radius: Vertical radius in which to search for holes.
settings.vertical-speed-match: Matches your vertical speed to your horizontal speed, otherwise uses vanilla ratio.
settings.vignette: Disables rendering of the vignette overlay.
settings.visual-range: Notifies you when an entity enters your render distance.
settings.walk-home: Will walk 'home' when your inventory is full.
settings.walls-range: Range in which to place anchors when behind blocks.
settings.waypoint-fade-distance: The distance to a waypoint at which it begins to start fading.
settings.weapon: What type of weapon to use.
settings.web: Whether or not cobwebs will not slow you down.
settings.web-timer: The timer value for WebMode Timer.
settings.webs: Whether to show holes that have webs inside of them.
settings.when-holding-right-click: Works only when holding right click.
settings.while-in-screens: Whether to click while a screen is open.
settings.while-moving: Allows you to tower while moving.
settings.width: The width of the shader outline.
settings.wind-burst: Swaps to a Mace with Wind Burst to launch up when hitting while falling.
settings.word-wrap: Prevents words from being cut in the middle of lines.
settings.world-border: Disables rendering of the world border.
settings.xcarry: Allows you to store four extra item stacks in your crafting grid.
settings.y-modifier: How much should the Y position of the ghost change per second.
settings.yaw: The yaw angle to look at when using simple rotation lock in bounce mode.
settings.yaw-lock: Whether to enable yaw lock or not
settings.yaw-lock-mode: The way in which your yaw is locked.
settings.yaw-steps: Maximum number of degrees its allowed to rotate in one tick.
settings.yaw-steps-mode: When to run the yaw steps check.
